policy_rules.policy_title: Device permissions to access personal data
policy_rules.policy_description: Depending on your specific device, the App may request permissions that allow access to your device data as described below. By default, these permissions must be granted by you before the relevant information can be read. After granting permission, you can revoke it at any time in your device settings. The exact way to manage permissions may depend on your device and software. Please note that revoking such permissions may affect the proper functioning of the App. If you grant any of the permissions listed below, the corresponding personal data may be processed (i.e., accessed, modified, or deleted) by Noti.

The App does not collect personal data. Data created by the user in Noti (i.e., calendar entries, tasks, and notes) is stored locally, and only the user has access to it. Noti does not share this data with third parties nor store it in the cloud.

The Noti app does not create user accounts and does not collect contact details. If you contact us voluntarily by email or through notiapp.org, we may process the information you provide only to answer your message and handle your request.

Created data—i.e., tasks, notes, calendar entries, settings, and optional images—is stored locally on the user's device. The app does not share this data with third parties and does not store it in the cloud. Only the user has access to it from their device, unless the user independently exports or shares a Noti backup file using system tools or another app.

The Noti app does not track users across apps or websites, so browser Do-Not-Track signals do not affect the app's operation. The notiapp.org website may receive standard technical requests from your browser, but we do not use them to track your activity across third-party services.

You can delete data created in the app by selecting the settings icon (gear), then “settings” from the right-hand menu, and then the “Trash” tab—there you can decide after what time data will be deleted. Data stored by the app is also removed from the device when the app is uninstalled. If you contacted us by email or through the website, you may request deletion of the contact information you provided.

In some regions, such as the European Economic Area (EEA) and the United Kingdom, you have rights regarding personal data that may be processed when you contact us or use the website. These may include the right to request access, rectification, deletion, restriction of processing, and—where applicable—data portability. In certain circumstances, you may also object to processing or withdraw consent. To make a request, please use the contact details below. If you believe that your data is being processed unlawfully, you may complain to your local data protection authority.

If you are a California resident, you may have specific rights regarding personal data. Noti does not sell personal data and the app does not disclose user-created notes, tasks, calendar entries, or images to third parties. If you contacted us and want to make a privacy request, please send it to the email address provided below.

The Noti app does not use cookies. The notiapp.org website may use technically necessary cookies or similar browser storage if needed for basic site operation. You can manage cookies in your browser settings.

If we make changes to this Privacy Policy in the future, we will not reduce your rights under this Policy without your explicit consent. We will always indicate the date of the last update. If the changes are significant, we will provide more prominent notice (including—where appropriate for certain services—an email notification about changes to the Privacy Policy). Please check for updates periodically. By continuing to use Noti, you accept the updated policy.
If you have questions about this Policy, email r85unit@gmail.com with the subject 'Privacy Questions' or visit notiapp.org/#contact.
